description: This file defines a React component 'MindmapCanvas' that renders an interactive mind map visualization with zoom, pan, and node selection capabilities. It includes layout computation functions, node rendering, and event handlers to support user interactions for a career pathway visualization.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Constrains a number between a minimum and maximum value.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value of unknown type into a trimmed string.

methods.name: isLikelyStepNode
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a node is a step or milestone based on its type or title.

methods.name: computeLevels
methods.description: Calculates hierarchical levels for nodes based on edges and a center node.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Determines the positions of nodes in a designed layout for the mind map, according to levels and heuristics.

methods.name: wrapLabel
methods.description: Wraps long labels into multiple lines with a maximum number of characters and lines, adding ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: nodeVisualKind
methods.description: Assigns visual styles (circle, pill, step) based on node characteristics.
